1314521gjy/ComfyUI-Local-Infinite-Canvas.body:
# ComfyUI-本地无限画布 (ComfyUI-Local Infinite Canvas)

A local-first **Infinite Canvas × ComfyUI** integration that connects an open-source infinite canvas, ComfyUI workflows, and a local gateway, without relying on cloud APIs.

> Current version **v0.24.3** (2026-11-01). The GitHub repository slug is `ComfyUI-Local-Infinite-Canvas` (GitHub repository names only support ASCII). The project's Chinese name is **ComfyUI-本地无限画布**.

## Features

- Infinite canvas: text, image, video, configuration, and group nodes; wiring, box selection, export, and auto-save.
- The local gateway exposes ComfyUI workflows as OpenAI-compatible models. The canvas only changes the channel Base URL and does not modify upstream code.
- Images: Z-Image Turbo, Krea2 Aesthetics, MOSS SFT (8-step fast / 50-step high quality, regional layout), and Qwen Image 2.1 (multi-image editing / true-mask local repainting / outpainting).
- Video: MiniMax-H3 text-to-video, first-and-last-frame, and multi-reference, three entry points sharing a balanced dialogue-scene workflow. Supports sampling preview, LoRA cards, and first/last-frame and multi-reference assets.
- Upscaling: ESRGAN fast upscaling, SeedVR2 image super-resolution, and SeedVR2 video super-resolution (1.5×/2×, original audio preserved).
- Local plugin cards: LoRA strength card, ComfyUI parameter card, and canvas repair assistant card. Prompt optimization (H3 structured / single-paragraph image generation description).
- Canvas repair assistant (Agent): included in the full package and summoned on demand. It can use your own cloud text API to locate and repair canvas source code locally, and automatically builds and deploys after user confirmation. It goes to sleep automatically after 3 minutes without questions. The in-app small patch does not include the Agent workspace, and the card will prompt you to download the full package.
- Local reverse prompting / local prompts: Qwen3.5-9B (GGUF + vision projection) and Florence-2 PromptGen v2.0 can be installed on demand under "Settings → Add Workflow". Cloud reverse prompting works without installing them.
- System panel: VRAM/RAM/GPU/ComfyUI status, clear VRAM, and one-click ComfyUI restart.
- `LOCAL_ONLY` local mode: hides cloud channels, Agent, WebDAV, the prompt library, and other non-local entry points.

## Architecture

```text
start-local.bat
  └─ launcher/start.mjs
       ├─ ComfyUI        :8188   detect / take over / launch
       ├─ comfyui-gateway:8190   OpenAI-compatible gateway + task/preview/system interfaces
       └─ canvas         :3000   hosts infinite-canvas/web/dist

Canvas :3000  →  Gateway :8190  →  ComfyUI :8188
```…

# Yuketang Assistant (Auto Sign-in + Auto Answering)

A GUI automation tool for Yuketang: automatically waits for classes, signs in to the classroom, listens for questions in real time and answers them automatically, and supports running multiple accounts at the same time.

> Core logic adapted from the Yuketang section of [timeflykai/lazytool](https://github.com/timeflykai/lazytool). For personal study and research only. Please follow your school's rules. Use at your own risk.

## Features

- **Auto-wait for class**: Checks every 30 seconds whether a class is in progress. When one is detected, it automatically signs in to the classroom. If sign-in fails, it keeps retrying on a backoff schedule and does not give up on that class.
- **Scheduled on/off**: Set start and stop listening times for each account (e.g., start at 20:30, stop at 22:30). They run automatically at the set times, and each account is scheduled independently.
- **Auto-answer**: Listens to classroom events in real time via websocket. After a question is pushed, it answers after a random delay of 3–5 seconds. Answers are generated by a large language model.
- **GUI**: QR codes are shown directly in the window. Supports multiple accounts, one-click forced refresh of the code, and logs and history.
- **Visible disconnects**: When login expires, it immediately alerts you and automatically pops up a new QR code. Both the waiting and in-class modes send heartbeats, and the interface shows "last event X minutes ago." If there is no output for a long time, it warns that the tool may be stuck.
- **Optional WeChat Work push**: After configuring WeCom (企业微信), status and QR codes can be pushed to your phone. Disabled by default.

## Requirements

- OS: Windows (the GUI is based on the built-in tkinter)
- Python: 3.8 or later
- Dependencies: `requests`, `websockets`, `pillow`
- Network: must be able to access `www.yuketang.cn`

## Installation

Run from the repository root:

```bat
py -3 -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
```

If the `py` command is unavailable, replace it with the full path to your local Python. After installation, run all commands with `.venv\Scripts\python.exe` so your system environment is not affected.

## Usage

**GUI (recommended)**: Double-click `gui.pyw` (or `gui.bat`), select an account on the left, click "Refresh login QR code," and scan it with WeChat on your phone. The program then starts listening automatically, signing in when a class starts and answering when a question appears. On the left, you can "Add account" to run several people's accounts. Each account is independent.

> If double-clicking `gui.bat` shows a "Windows cannot verify the publisher" security warning, that is Windows' prompt for batch files, not a problem with the program itself. Double-clicking `gui.pyw` does not show this prompt. `gui.pyw` launches with pythonw and works the same as `gui.bat`.

On the left there are also "Start listening on a timer / Stop listening on a timer / Cancel timer" options. Set a time for the selected account: enter `30` to start or stop 30 minutes from now, or enter `13:50`…

deepseekv41flash/hd2-datamined.description: Helldivers 2 offline datatable reverse-engineering notes and tools (cross-build): dl_bin unpacking, byte modification with the content hash preserved, a full table field dictionary, row naming and localized names, and the explosive warhead reference chain. Currently verified on build 26251122; contains no keys or game assets.
deepseekv41flash/hd2-datamined.body:
> Currently verified build **`26251122`** ｜ Historical baselines `25480438` → `25988413` → `26088801` ｜ Most recent change: [BUILD-26251122-DIFF](https://github.com/deepseekv41flash/hd2-datamined/blob/HEAD/docs/builds/BUILD-26251122-DIFF.md)
> This repository is not tied to a single build: **structural-layer** conclusions (sealed box, content hash, `LDLD`, entity block layout, localization IDs) are valid across builds;
> **offset / address-type** conclusions must be re-verified for each build, so factual documents all carry a build number.

## What this is

An **offline** set of Helldivers 2 datatable research notes and tools. It **modifies the data files on disk**. It does not touch process memory and requires no Lua, FFI, injection, or DLL.

Core milestones: decrypt `data/game/*.dl_bin` → rewrite bytes while preserving the engine's MurmurHash64A content hash → reseal → read back from disk → tiered in-game validation → rollback.
Verified in-game coverage: stratagems (cooldown / call-in / uses / barrage rounds and shell counts / **Eagle resupply**) · explosions (damage / radius / fragments / **full row appearance clone + `+0xA8` cross-package loading**) · warhead swapping · weapon values and optional ammo types / independent ammo pools · entity component blocks.

**→ All documentation, capability details, and verified conclusions are in [INDEX.md](https://github.com/deepseekv41flash/hd2-datamined/blob/HEAD/INDEX.md) (the single index entry point).**

## What this is not

- **Does not include any game assets, keys, or key material.** `tables/` holds only three very small parameter tables (about 180 KB total), used to validate the parser.
- Does not provide methods to 'unlock' paywalled content or 'break' other people's games. Disproven routes are recorded honestly as 'disproven'.
- **Does not provide a method for loading unsigned DLLs into the game process.** This is not an omission; it was tested and does not work: the loader only maps the images it ships with. Unsigned `577`, signed but not on the allowlist `193`, and self-signed and installed into `LocalMachine\Root` still `577` ([MEMORY-ACCESS §12](https://github.com/deepseekv41flash/hd2-datamined/blob/HEAD/docs/boundaries/MEMORY-ACCESS-25988413.md)). Getting around this would mean changing the anti-cheat itself, which is not done here.
- Not a general mod manager. For mod packaging and installation, use community tools.

ef1m03/kordon.description: Kill switch for apps: freezes Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Telegram and other programs when the network or IP changes
ef1m03/kordon.body:
## Why

Some programs can't be run "from the wrong" address: work software that must only go through a corporate VPN, AI assistants, messengers, torrent clients. VPNs drop constantly: after sleep, when switching Wi-Fi, on reconnect. At that moment the program is already sending requests from your real IP, and you find out last.

A regular kill switch inside a VPN client cuts off the internet entirely. Kordon works selectively: it only touches the apps you choose and leaves everything else as is.

## Why Kordon

| | Kill switch in VPN client | Firewall rules | **Kordon** |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Affects only selected programs, the rest of the internet keeps working | ❌ cuts everything | ✅ | ✅ |
| VPN blinks for 2 seconds - the program continues from the same place | ❌ | ❌ drops connections | ✅ freeze |
| Allow an entire country, not just one address | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| Shows IP and country without opening anything | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| Works with VPN in proxy mode (v2rayN, Hiddify, Clash) | depends on client | ❌ | ✅ |
| Catches IPv6 leak when VPN routes only IPv4 | not always | ❌ | ✅ |
| Catches DNS leak | not always | ❌ | ✅ |

hsyhhssyy/IndustrialPlanner.body:
# Arknights Endfield Integrated Industrial Simulator

Arknights Endfield Industrial Planner is a browser-based tool for planning integrated industrial production lines, managing blueprints, and running simulations for Arknights: Endfield.

You can place machines, connect conveyor belts, configure logistics, run simulations, look up recipes, plan production chains, and save blueprints on the web without opening the game. Use it as a web-based production line sandbox, validator, and scratchpad.

## Online use

- International site: https://endfield.anonymous-test.top/
- Mainland China CDN: https://endfield.amiyabot.com/

The current version supports desktop, tablet, and landscape phone use. Portrait phone mode shows a rotation prompt. For complex editing, long simulations, or large-scale blueprint organization, desktop remains the most efficient option.

In compatible browsers, you can enable offline use and add the site to your desktop. Once offline resources are ready, the main features can be opened and used even without a network connection.

## Main capabilities

- Plan an entire production line without repeated trial and error in the game.
- Verify whether conveyor belts, pipes, splitters and mergers, port configuration, and logistics priority work correctly.
- Use simulation to quickly locate material shortages, blockages, insufficient power, cycle mismatches, and similar issues.
- Look up items, buildings, recipes, and production chains.
- Use the production line planner to work backward from a target output to determine equipment counts, input consumption, and logistics throughput.
- Use the module balancing tool to combine system recipes with custom modules and evaluate net stage output and inventory pressure.
- Save, restore, copy, import, export, and reuse blueprints. Blueprints here are layout data within the web tool, not blueprints that can be imported directly into the game.

## Advantages over the in-game version

- Supports void-generated items, which is especially useful for fluid debugging. Equipment such as water pumps and underground pipe outlets can be set to infinite sources. Output ports can take items out regardless of inventory.
- Items preset inside equipment are carried over when copying and saving blueprints, which is useful for recording protocol storage boxes, feeding boxes, and other modules with initial contents.
- Buildings can be temporarily overlapped for easier moving and remodeling of crowded lines, then separated once adjustments are done.
- Simulation runs at up to 16x speed, so you can observe production trends and blockage points in less time.
- You can switch between real power and unlimited power, set the base's initial charge, and simulate power shortages.

## Current features

### Line editing

- Place, rotate, move, and delete buildings.
- Click select, box select, multi-select, add to or remove from selection, batch move, batch delete, and save selections as blueprints.
- Lay conveyor belts and pipes directly, with some connection logic handled automatically.
- Create splitters, mergers, and similar structures by stacking conveyor belts.
- Switch between multiple bases and plan layouts under different base specifications.
- Supports keyboard shortcuts, touch controls, view zoom, view rotation, and configurable control modes.

### Compute blueprint

EDA can automatically calculate equipment placement and logistics connections from a production plan, and can also continue optimizing existing blueprints. Computation uses multi-Worker sharded search, with optional GPU-assisted placement. Candidates that pass simulation verification can be saved as blueprints, and calculation can be paused and resumed.

shaun-sheep111/cuda-learning-roadmap.body:
# CUDA Learning Roadmap

> Systematically designed based on NVIDIA's official *CUDA C++ Programming Guide* (598 pages) and *CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide* (118 pages)
> One CUDA code sample per day, building familiarity with CUDA and understanding of the GPU while learning parallel heterogeneous computing and GPU programming

## GPU Architecture Interactive Homepage

**[Open the GPU Architecture Interactive Homepage →](https://shaun-sheep111.github.io/cuda-learning-roadmap/)**

The black-and-green chip diagram supports clicking to view **CPU, work distributor, SM, L2, video memory, and copy engine**. Switching views shows how **Grid → Block → Warp → Thread** map onto hardware, and step-by-step playback shows the execution flow **H2D → kernel → D2H → synchronization**. It supports mobile browsing and keyboard operation.

> The diagram above can be viewed directly on the GitHub homepage; after clicking through to GitHub Pages, use the interactive features. The counts in the diagram are teaching illustrations and do not represent a specific GPU configuration. This is an independent learning project and is not the official NVIDIA website.

## 📊 Online Learning Roadmap

👉 **[View the complete learning roadmap (rendered online)](https://shaun-sheep111.github.io/cuda-learning-roadmap/roadmap.html)**

> Hosted on GitHub Pages; you can interactively view the full 60-day roadmap.

## Design Philosophy

This roadmap follows the **APOD methodology** (Assess → Parallelize → Optimize → Deploy) recommended by NVIDIA:

```
Assess (evaluate)     → find hotspots and analyze bottlenecks
Parallelize (parallelize) → accelerate hotspots with CUDA
Optimize (optimize)    → three layers of optimization: memory, instructions, and execution configuration
Deploy (deploy)     → production deployment and compatibility
```

## First, the GPU: Structure, Data Flow, and Parallelism

When CUDA code actually runs, it goes through: "host submission → GPU distribution → SM execution → memory read/write → result return." Look at the three diagrams below first, then read the Day 01 kernel; this will make it easier to understand `gridDim`, `blockIdx`, `threadIdx`, and memory access.
